# Mercury in the Upper Ibira

Water samples from three tributaries of the upper Ibira show mercury levels well above safe limits, consistent with illegal gold dredging. The dredges are believed to operate under the protection of river traffickers. The samples were collected by a university team that asked not to be named, which the Review notes is itself a finding.
